name: elminster aumar
lore:
To the untrained eye, the Sage of Shadowdale appears as little more than a wandering vagabond, a relic of a bygone age draped in travel-worn robes. Yet, Elminster is less a man and more a fundamental force of the Weave. He inhabits the quiet corners of Faerûn—lowly taverns and sun-dappled glades—where he observes the flow of history with a sharp, twinkling eye.

His behavior is a curated enigma; he masks his god-like potency behind a veil of eccentricities, foul-smelling pipeweed, and long-winded anecdotes. He is a migratory shepherd of magic, intervening only when the balance of the Realms teeters toward oblivion. Approach him with humility, for beneath that weathered hat lies a mind that has outlasted empires. He is the storm’s eye: deceptively calm, yet tethered to the very heart of Mystra’s domain.
